entities.summary: The Royal Foundation of St Katharine is a religious charity based in the East End of London. The Foundation traces its origins back to the medieval church and monastic hospital St Katharine's by the Tower, established in 1147, next to the Tower of London. Royal Foundation of St Katharine is a church building in Europe, established in 1147. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
